technical_requirements: Line weight must be at least 0.5pt, standard 1-2pt for children
Minimum coloring space of 0.25 inches between elements
best_practices: Break up large areas with subtle details
Vary pattern density for visual interest
age_specific_guidelines: Ages 3-8: Large spaces, simple shapes, bold lines, basic subjects
Ages 9-12: Medium complexity, varied subjects, some detail work
Teens/Adults: Complex patterns, fine details, challenging designs
